text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I'll leave the documents for Shakur-san
on her desk."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Phew... Maybe I should air the room out a bit.
(WHOOOOSH!!)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whoa-aaah!? The wind...!
Th-The documents are flying awayyyy!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hau! Wait!
Don't leave, I'm o-over hereee~!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What the heck are you doing...
Practicing dance in a place like this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'm, I'm so sorry! The wind blew away the documents meant for Shakur-san!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
You'll never recover anything moving like that.
Listen up: you gotta use your body efficiently!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyoeh! I'm s-s-so s-sorry
for being so dreadfully slow!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna fix that sloppy form of yours. Move exactly as I tell you, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Wind direction is southeast, speed looks to be around 3 m/s.
And calculating from where the paper is now—"

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, dash on the count!
3, 2, 1... Now! Go!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Awawa... T-Take that!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: All right, got it! On to the next one!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: This time, run all the way over there!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeees!!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! Time for the finishing touch, Doto!
You'd better make a diving catch in four seconds flat!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: T-Take thaaat—... Oof?!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, took it right to the face at the very end.
...Minimum effort for maximum results, huh.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I think I've finally gotten the hang of the movement...!

Later on, Meisho Doto's running
had gained even more sharpness!
